statements.quote: Revenues for the year ended June 30, 2026 for Datacenter & Communications increased 40% to $5,275 million, compared to $3,755 million last fiscal year.
statements.notes: Datacenter & Communications segment revenue; the segment also includes telecom/communications products, so this is broader than AI datacenter revenue alone. Growth is attributed primarily to AI datacenter demand in the next sentence.

statements.quote: On March 2, 2026, the Company entered into a multi-year strategic agreement with NVIDIA to advance the development of advanced optics technologies, including manufacturing capacity and research and development, to enable next-generation AI infrastructure.
statements.notes: Agreement links future manufacturing capacity investment to AI infrastructure; it describes an agreement rather than stated spend. The $2 billion NVIDIA equity investment is financing received, not company spend, so it is not recorded.

statements.quote: We are investing in manufacturing capacity for the Datacenter and Communications markets, including expanding our indium phosphide capacity in Sherman, Texas, to address our increased customer demand and industry-wide shortage.
statements.notes: Capacity investment is for the Datacenter and Communications markets. The sentence does not name AI, although the surrounding paragraph attributes datacenter demand to AI. No amount is stated.
